project_info.summary: This is a Generative AI Chatbot Application built on AWS that leverages Amazon Bedrock for LLM capabilities and LangChain for conversational continuity. The application implements a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architecture with a knowledge base (OpenSearch/Vector DB), chat history storage (DynamoDB), and content moderation via Bedrock Guardrails. The threat model identifies critical security concerns aligned with OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, including: (1) Prompt Injection attacks via direct and indirect methods, (2) Sensitive Information Disclosure through model memorization and insufficient data anonymization, (3) Supply Chain Vulnerabilities from third-party models and plugins, (4) Improper Output Handling leading to XSS and code injection, (5) Excessive Agency risks from autonomous LLM agents, and (6) Data Poisoning threats. The application prioritizes confidentiality of RAG data as the highest security priority, with moderate priority on data integrity and lower priority on availability. Key security controls include Bedrock Guardrails for responsible AI, data anonymization techniques, differential privacy, statistical disclosure controls, and comprehensive access controls. The architecture spans multiple AWS services with distinct trust boundaries between user interactions, API processing, LLM inference, knowledge base access, and downstream system integration.
